title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

London | Hybrid | £60,000

This is an excellent opportunity for a Data Analyst to join a highly regarded organisation where data plays a central role in shaping marketing, customer, and business decisions. You'll work across a variety of analytics projects, gain exposure to modern data technologies and AI-powered insight generation, and have the chance to develop ownership of client-facing deliverables from an early stage.

The Company

They are a well-established organisation operating at the intersection of data, technology, and customer strategy. Their teams help businesses make smarter decisions through analytics, insight generation, and measurement frameworks that drive performance. They foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where curiosity, learning, and innovation are encouraged.

The Role

You will support the delivery of data analytics projects that help stakeholders better understand customer behaviour, campaign performance, and business outcomes.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Analysing customer, marketing, sales, and operational datasets to generate actionable insights
  • Supporting test-and-learn programmes and measurement initiatives
  • Producing post-campaign analysis and performance reporting
  • Building customer profiles and audience insights
  • Developing KPI frameworks and measurement approaches
  • Contributing to customer journey and experience optimisation projects
  • Using data and AI-enabled tools to uncover trends and opportunities
  • Presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders

Your Skills & Experience

  • Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python
  • Ability to query and extract data from cloud-based environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Experience working with customer, marketing, sales, product, or consumer datasets
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and a naturally inquisitive mindset
  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across multiple teams

Desirable experience includes:

  • Web analytics or social media analytics
  • Dashboarding and data visualisation tools
  • Statistics and experimentation
  • Customer segmentation or modelling
  • Marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce, Braze, Adobe, or related tools
  • Campaign analysis and customer journey optimisation

What They Offer

  • Exposure to a broad range of analytics and customer insight projects
  • Opportunity to develop client-facing and presentation skills
  • Collaborative environment with strong learning and development opportunities
  • Potential for longer-term career progression within a growing analytics function

How to Apply

If you're a Data Analyst with strong SQL or Python skills and a passion for turning data into meaningful business insights, apply today to learn more about this opportunity.
